name: TermsBuilder Legal Documents
author: termsbuilder

sections.description:
TermsBuilder creates legal documents from a questionnaire developed by a practicing ecommerce attorney. This plugin connects your WordPress website to your TermsBuilder account and displays the documents you purchased.

Connect your account, choose your business, and publish your legal documents. You can also place a document on an existing page using a shortcode.

The plugin stores each document for up to six hours. After that period, the next page visit retrieves its latest version from TermsBuilder. You can refresh documents immediately from the plugin settings.

The plugin is free. A TermsBuilder account and purchased documents are required. Documents are available through individual purchases or Auto Updates, an optional subscription that includes documents and ongoing legal updates. Current prices are at https://termsbuilder.com/pricing.

External services

This plugin connects to TermsBuilder at https://termsbuilder.com to retrieve your documents and check your account connection. Requests include your account identifier or API key and standard server request information, including your server’s IP address.

When you click Connect, your browser sends your website address and return address to TermsBuilder. After you sign in and choose your business, WordPress exchanges a temporary connection code for an API key. The plugin stores that key in your WordPress database.

TermsBuilder’s terms are at https://termsbuilder.com/our-terms. Its privacy policy is at https://termsbuilder.com/our-privacy-policy.
sections.installation:
You need a WordPress administrator account and your purchased documents ready in TermsBuilder.

  1. In WordPress, open Plugins and add a new plugin. Search for TermsBuilder Legal Documents, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Open Settings, then TermsBuilder, and click Connect to TermsBuilder.
  3. Sign in to TermsBuilder, choose your business, and click Connect to return to WordPress.
  4. Click Publish Legal Documents to publish your available terms, privacy policy, and cookie policy.
  5. Add or confirm links to those documents in your website footer or menu, then open each link to check it.

Existing published pages are preserved. To use an existing page, replace its old policy text with a Shortcode block containing the matching code shown in the plugin settings.

Automatic legal updates require Auto Updates. Additional notices and privacy tools shown in your TermsBuilder dashboard need their separate setup.
sections.faq:
Do I need a TermsBuilder account?

Yes. You need a TermsBuilder account with generated documents that you purchased individually or received through Auto Updates.

When will document changes appear?

The plugin retrieves the latest version on the first page visit after its six hour cache expires. Click Refresh documents now to clear that cache immediately.

What happens if TermsBuilder cannot respond?

After the cached document expires, the plugin displays a link to its hosted version on TermsBuilder.

Does the plugin change pages I already created?

Publish Legal Documents preserves existing published pages. You can add a TermsBuilder shortcode to a page yourself.

1.0.3

  • Use Publish Legal Documents for the publishing button.
  • Explain document publication, navigation links, and refresh timing in the installation instructions.

1.0.2

  • Document titles are centered, and document text uses 12 pt sizing.
  • This release includes legal document display and refresh features.
  • The optional consent banner is excluded from this release.

1.0.1

  • Delete the stored API key, connection state, and cached connection status during uninstall.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.3.

1.0.0

  • First release. One-press account connection, document shortcodes, one-click page creation, six-hour refresh, optional consent banner.
